newsitem.title: USA: New Hanover Cty, N.C., seeks $125 mln school GOs.
newsitem.headline: New Hanover Cty, N.C., seeks $125 mln school GOs.

text.p: North Carolina's New Hanover County School Board voted to ask county commissioners for a referendum on $125 million of general obligation bonds for schools, the Wilmington Star-News said Friday.

School officials hope to put the bonds on the ballot later this spring. Proceeds would fund construction of five new schools, renovation of three schools, improvement of athletic facilities and the purchse of technology and equipment.
